description: Angular component class for configuring a basic map widget in the Thingsboard platform, including form setup, default settings, and UI logic.

classes.name: MapBasicConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component for configuring map widget settings, including form controls, default setup, and validation logic.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the form group for the widget configuration.

methods.name: setupConfig
methods.description: Initializes component state based on provided widget configuration data.

methods.name: setupDefaults
methods.description: Sets default values for map settings, clearing existing markers, polygons, circles, and trips if applicable.

methods.name: onConfigSet
methods.description: Merges default settings with current configuration and initializes the form with these values.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Prepares and saves the current form data back into the widget configuration.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.

methods.name: getCardButtons
methods.description: Determines which card buttons (e.g., fullscreen) should be enabled based on widget config.

methods.name: setCardButtons
methods.description: Sets the enabled state of card buttons in widget config.

methods.name: displayTimewindowConfig
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if the timewindow configuration should be displayed.

methods.name: onlyHistoryTimewindow
methods.description: Boolean getter indicating if only history timewindow is applicable.
